errorReportingReview.finding: A drain batch discarded every error after its first queued error or throwing listener.
errorReportingReview.fix: Report one error per checkpoint and leave later messages queued; reuse the existing wake and retirement path.
errorReportingReview.baselineNegativeControl: The previous V8 implementation delivered one of three throwing listener errors.

imageCacheReview.finding: Expired global image-cache entries were retained in production; the test statistic erased them and masked the leak.
imageCacheReview.fix: The final Image owner removes the expired weak entry. Load/unload runs outside the cache mutex; a second lookup preserves concurrent reuse. Resource statistics are read-only.
negativeControls: The preceding implementation with a read-only image count retained one entry after teardown.
Cleaning only during State sweep/retirement still retained one entry when a dynamic-library NativeFinalizer factory survived until VM destruction.

findings.problem: Two Session cleanup lists each pinned the same image, preventing either list from releasing it after both libraries closed.
findings.fix: Per-Session Image references share one weakly cached SharedImage loader handle; each Session can release its own last reference.
findings.negativeControl: Both library closes release the shared image before Session destruction

findings.problem: A surviving finalizer factory could retain its image beyond Session retirement and release it on the Hermes finalizer worker.
findings.fix: Retirement clears each closed Session image reference on the owner after active work and cleanup finish; other Sessions keep their own references.
findings.negativeControl: Retirement releases images before surviving factories are collected

gcRaceReview.fixtureCorrection: The notification handler is created outside the attachment loop activation so its Hermes closure does not retain the last target. Repeated collections did not clear the original retained target; separating the handler did.
